data.title: Login returns 500 on Safari 17 with valid credentials
data.description: When a user signs in on Safari 17.4 (macOS 14.4), the server returns 500 instead of redirecting to the dashboard. Affects ~30% of macOS users in the last 24h based on Datadog error spike.
data.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open https://app.example.com/login in Safari 17.4
2. Enter a valid test email and password
3. Click the 'Sign in' button
4. Observe the response
data.expected_result: User is authenticated, session cookie is set, and the page redirects to /dashboard within 2 seconds.
data.actual_result: Server responds with HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'. Safari console shows a CORS preflight failure for /api/v1/auth.
data.environment: macOS 14.4 · Safari 17.4 · app build 2.3.1 · account role: standard user

data.title: Checkout total wrong when applying 10% coupon on cart > 5 items
data.description: When a cart has 5 or more items and a 10% coupon is applied, the displayed total is incorrect by a few cents. Reproduced on staging and production.
data.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Add 6 items to cart (mix of SKUs)
2. Apply coupon code 'WELCOME10'
3. View cart total
data.expected_result: Total should be (subtotal × 0.90) rounded to 2 decimal places
data.actual_result: Total is (subtotal × 0.90) − 0.03, off by 3 cents on every order

data.title: GET /api/v1/orders times out for accounts with > 10k orders
data.description: Account tier 'enterprise' accounts with more than 10,000 orders experience a 30s timeout on GET /api/v1/orders. Smaller accounts respond in < 500ms. Suspect N+1 query in the orders endpoint.
data.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Sign in as enterprise user 'acme-corp'
2. curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.example.com/v1/orders?limit=50
3. Observe response time
data.expected_result: Response within 2s with a paginated list of orders
data.actual_result: 504 Gateway Timeout after 30s; nginx upstream log shows orders service did not return
data.environment: Ubuntu 22.04 · API service build 4.1.0 · Postgres 15 · k8s cluster prod-eu-west-1
